# UmaLytics 0.5.0

## Redesign

- **Header:** Live / History / Players, Lobby / Draft / Umas scenes and Season / All-time in one slim header.
- **Lobby cards:** rank chip, badges, four core stats and each player's top three Umas.
- **Player drawer:** details open beside the lobby with title, a sortable Uma table and paged match history.
- **Badges:** One-trick, Deep pool, Podium regular, Underrated and Newcomer.
- **Uma League team icons** on lobby cards, in the player drawer and on the Players page.
- **Draft:** team / races / team columns with a phase bar, race cards (track, distance and conditions), pick experience and ban/veto rows.
- **Umas:** searchable, sortable catalog with lobby and per-team experience.
- **Players:** search the season leaderboard or open a profile by URL or Discord ID, using the same drawer as the lobby.
- **History:** completed matches use the same Lobby / Draft / Umas scenes and drawer.
- **UI size:** Small / Default / Large in the header menu. The scouting window remembers its size and position.

## Performance and privacy

- API requests are spaced at least 350 ms apart (previously 500 ms), with the same rate-limit backoff.
- Match history is displayed in player details, including for players with hidden stats, but never used to calculate ranked statistics. Hidden ranked stats stay hidden.

## Update

Download and extract the ZIP for your browser. Disable the previous extension, load the new build, reopen UmaLytics and refresh your drafter tabs. Confirm **v0.5.0** in the header.

The Chromium ZIP supports Chrome, Edge, Brave and Opera GX. Firefox / LibreWolf uses an unsigned temporary add-on, which must be loaded again after a browser restart. SHA256SUMS.txt contains optional download integrity checksums.

Automated regression, type and build checks passed before release; they do not replace live installed-browser testing.
